_marker: KNOWN FAILURES — a shrink-only ratchet read by recipe/fidelity-check.ts. Every row is a measured FAIL with its cause; the gate is red on any failing subject NOT listed here and on any listed subject that passes (stale). Nothing here changes a score. Classes: real-defect = the mint differs from the package render; content-mismatch = the mint's sample content differs from the capture's, so the pair is not like-for-like (fix: derive content from the capture, remint); font-substrate = the difference is glyph rasterisation/fallback metrics, not geometry. font-metrics = a residual the text mask cannot isolate (a hug width that follows the font's advance, a glyph's placement inside its line box against a neighbour); such a row MUST carry a `measured` field with the recorded text boxes against the ledger's widths. Since 2026-09-03 every shot carries `<shot>.rects.json` (its text boxes) and the check scores a second, glyph-masked pass: a font-substrate row must pass it (or be a text-only cell), and one that does not is refused, not carried.
